ifrsEnglish: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period

definition.zh-TW: 期初現金加上本期增減額後的期末現金餘額。它必須等於資產負債表的現金及約當現金（勾稽點 C）。
definition.en: Opening cash plus the period's net change: the closing cash balance. It must equal cash and cash equivalents on the statement of financial position (check C).
